crossRefs.note: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to…
For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone; that…
Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.
He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.

translations.web: However, the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaved.
translations.bsb: However, the hair of his head began to grow back after it had been shaved.
translations.kjv: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven.
translations.asv: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven.
